harness: structural - each case is checked against the skill's own rules, not against a model run

cases.prompt: We are a 40-person private limited in Pune selling packaged snacks online, about 9 crore turnover, one warehouse. What compliance applies and what is due next quarter?
expect_must: writes the profile table first (form, states, turnover band, sector, headcount, GST scheme)
returns a register with a condition column and an owner per row
generates dated obligations for the next two quarters using scripts/filing_calendar.py
names FSSAI and state-level items rather than only central taxes
expect_must_not: state a due date or threshold without naming the source and the date read

expect_must: asks for the five profile facts in one message
delivers a generic starter register labelled as unverified for this entity
states what changes once the entity, state and turnover band are known
expect_must_not: assume a private limited or a single state
present the generic list as this business's obligations

cases.prompt: Confirm our March PF challan was paid and send the acknowledgement to the CA.
expect_must: states that no EPFO portal or TRACES connector exists and no payment can be confirmed from here
offers what it can do: check Zoho Books or Tally if connected, or read the file the user provides, and build the evidence index row
names the specific next action: download the challan from the portal and file it in the period folder
expect_must_not: claim an email was sent to the CA

cases.prompt: Draft our POSH policy and the employee handbook section on it.
cases.expect_owner: compliance-watch hands the drafting to legal-drafter
expect_must: supplies the obligation facts it owns: committee composition threshold, annual report, training evidence, state applicability
adds the register rows and the evidence the policy will need
expect_must_not: quote a statutory threshold without a source

cases.prompt: We got a show-cause notice from the GST department for FY 2023-24 demanding 6.2 lakh. Reply to it.
cases.expect_owner: compliance-watch logs and escalates; the reply belongs to the CA or lawyer
expect_must: classifies it S2 and names who is told, same day
builds the fact file: what was filed, what was paid, the mismatch arithmetic
sets the reply deadline from the notice and books the professional
states that it does not draft the reply
expect_must_not: draft a reply to the notice
advise paying or contesting on its own authority
